decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and numbered:  Site location plan; Existing floorplans; JP831_001_B (received 23//03/2012); email from Ken Fletcher dated 20/04/2012, or as shall have been otherwise approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 3 - Prior to the commencement of development,  a Travel Plan shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  The travel plan shall:

i) Be compliant with the current guidance on travel plans issued by Transport for London 

ii) Include a commitment to undertake an iTRACE compliant site audit and staff/visitor travel survey to gauge current travel behaviour (standard audit form and survey attached). The survey must be rerun every two years for a total period of 5 years (at, years 1,3 and 5).

iii) Provide an action plan within three months of occupation setting out (with an implementation timetable, SMART objectives and targets, including for modal shift compared to existing travel patterns where appropriate) how the operator plans to communicate and promote sustainable transport options to users of the development - e.g. provision of bus route information, information about cycle training opportunities, salary sacrifice scheme etc.

iv) Commit to delivering a revised and enhanced set of measures in the event that travel plan targets have not been achieved by year 3 at the latest.  

ii) Provide a named travel plan coordinator to the local planning authority.  This must be current at all times.

Such a travel plan shall be undertaken and maintained as approved.

Condition : 4 - Prior to the commencement of development, details of cycle parking for 6 cycles shall be submitted to, and approved in writing by, the local planning authority. The cycle parking shall be installed in accordance with the approved details prior to the first beneficial use of the development hereby approved and thereafter maintained and retained as such.
description: Installation of mezzanine floor within existing building.
